candidates.change_summary: Replace the balance update with an assignment so the deposit overwrites the balance instead of accumulating.
Delete the LogFile.AddMessage call so Put no longer records a log entry, changing observable history/LastMsg.
Replace the unlockTime assignment with the raw _unlockTime, allowing unlockTime in the past so Collect becomes possible earlier.
Replace the require guard so zero-value Puts revert, which the original allowed.
Change the logged value to 0 so the log entry (History/LastMsg Val) no longer reflects the deposited amount.
Delete the balance update so the caller's recorded balance is never decreased on withdrawal.
Move the balance decrement to after the external call, reintroducing the reentrancy window so the caller's recorded balance still shows the old value during the call.
Remove the unlockTime check so withdrawals succeed before the lock expires.
Change the minimum-balance guard from >= to > so withdrawals fail when balance equals MinSum exactly.
Change the amount guard from >= to > so withdrawals fail when the requested amount equals the balance exactly.
